effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T11d of the step "Complete multi-device worker and lifecycle acceptance". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent + 0.5 hours owner; agent work at the usual rate; the owner gives device access across the matrix. Method: NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge: median 0.56 h, p75 2.1 h, p90 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement) put a focused day at about 1.5 agent hours, with 0.75 h the least for one PR with review and CI. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history.
